title: 设计评审词汇
html:
设计评审词汇

概述

本章聚焦设计评审场景，分为评审结构、反馈语言、设计原则讨论、评审产出四个部分。它提供设计评审中常用的英语词汇，重点是如何在评审中给出建设性意见并形成结论。每个部分配有听说例句与写作表达，适合评审会议和讨论记录。建议把评审结构与反馈语言结合学习，理解设计评审的推进方式。

评审结构

词汇 词性 含义 常用搭配
design critique n. 设计评审 hold a critique, structured critique
presenter n. 展示者 design presenter, present the work
context n. 背景 provide context, design context
rationale n. 理由 design rationale, explain rationale
constraint n. 约束 technical constraint, business constraint
alternative n. 替代方案 explore alternatives, present alternatives

听说例句

A: Before we start the critique, can you provide some context? B: Sure. The design rationale is based on user research findings. We also explored two alternatives.

A: What were the main constraints? B: Timeline and technical limitations. The backend can't support real-time updates yet.

写作表达

  • A well-structured design critique begins with context and rationale before opening the floor for feedback.
  • Presenting alternatives alongside the recommended approach demonstrates thorough exploration of the design space.

反馈语言

词汇 词性 含义 常用搭配
intuitive adj. 直觉的 intuitive design, intuitive navigation
cluttered adj. 杂乱的 cluttered layout, avoid clutter
hierarchy n. 层次 visual hierarchy, clear hierarchy
whitespace n. 留白 add whitespace, effective whitespace
contrast n. 对比 color contrast, insufficient contrast
alignment n. 对齐 visual alignment, misaligned elements

听说例句

A: The layout feels a bit cluttered. Can we add more whitespace? B: Good point. I'll increase the spacing between sections to create a clearer visual hierarchy.

A: The CTA button doesn't have enough contrast with the background. B: I'll adjust the color. The alignment of the text also needs fixing.

写作表达

  • Effective use of whitespace and visual hierarchy reduces cognitive load and creates a more intuitive interface.
  • Ensuring sufficient color contrast meets accessibility standards and improves readability for all users.

设计原则讨论

词汇 词性 含义 常用搭配
user-centered adj. 以用户为中心的 user-centered design, UCD approach
data-informed adj. 数据驱动的 data-informed decision, data-informed design
scalable adj. 可扩展的 scalable design, scalable component
inclusive adj. 包容性的 inclusive design, inclusive experience
delightful adj. 令人愉悦的 delightful interaction, delightful moment
cohesive adj. 统一的 cohesive experience, cohesive brand

听说例句

A: Is this a user-centered design decision or a business-driven one? B: Both. The user research supports it, and the data-informed approach validates the expected impact.

A: How do we make the experience more inclusive? B: We should ensure the design is scalable for different languages and accessible for screen readers.

写作表达

  • A user-centered, data-informed approach ensures that design decisions are grounded in both empathy and evidence.
  • Inclusive design practices create cohesive experiences that are accessible and enjoyable for a diverse user base.

评审产出

词汇 词性 含义 常用搭配
action item n. 行动项 assign action items, follow up
iteration n. 迭代 next iteration, iterate on feedback
consensus n. 共识 reach consensus, build consensus
sign-off n. 签收 design sign-off, stakeholder approval
documentation n. 文档化 document decisions, design documentation
follow-up n. 跟进 schedule follow-up, follow-up review

听说例句

A: Did we reach consensus on the navigation redesign? B: Yes. The action items are to iterate on the mobile version and get stakeholder sign-off by Friday.

A: Should we document the design decisions from this critique? B: Absolutely. I'll update the design documentation and schedule a follow-up review next week.

写作表达

  • Design critiques produce actionable outputs including documented decisions, assigned action items, and clear next steps.
  • Building consensus during the critique process reduces revision cycles and accelerates the path to design sign-off.
